evidence: These colossal mechanical looms, with their robust metal frames, have become the centerpiece of a vibrant craft village that has evolved over centuries. The machines, though relatively recent additions to the village's landscape, embody the timeless tradition of silk weaving that was first imparted by the revered deity, Thành hoàng A Lã Thị Nương.

The rhythmic clatter of the shuttles and the rumbling of the motors now echo through the workshops, replacing the traditional clacking sounds of hand-operated looms, yet preserving the essence of the craft that has long defined Van Phuc. The machines, constructed with sturdy iron and steel, exude a modern industrial charm that contrasts beautifully with the vibrant hues of the silk threads they weave.
